role: The arena's types and capacities: struct arena, slot_pool, slab, sec_list (a chunk section's entity list as pool slot indices), arena_env; the slot accessors (pool_index, pool_at, an/ie/fh_ent_at and _index, an_ref/an_deref) and nw_arena() (struct env starts with its arena_env).
notes: ARENA_PATHS, ARENA_LIVINGS, ARENA_AN_ENTS, ARENA_IE_ENTS, ARENA_FH_ENTS, ARENA_DOORS and ARENA_SLAB_BYTES are the capacities. ARENA_NIBS: the bands' nibble arrays that are not one value (2 KB slots), after the sixteen constant arrays (lane/chunkmem).
